title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
premise: When the valley's anti-magic wards collapse on the night the stars vanish, temple scribe Ivo Nakamura is dragged beyond the only world he has ever known, bound by a debt he cannot refuse and a gift for unbinding spells that the wards were secretly suppressing. He discovers the stars were not extinguished but devoured by the Hollow Regent, a hungry entity wearing the king's crown, and that his own bloodline wrote the original binding that now fails. Guided by a disgraced ward-knight, Sera Voss, whose loyalty to duty wars with her growing love for him, Ivo must reach the capital and reforge the binding from within. In the end Ivo chooses to become the new living anchor of the wards — trading his freedom for the world's survival — while Sera defies her order to remain beside him, proving that belonging can be built rather than inherited.
about_author: I. M. Montrose is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval land charters before turning to fantasy. They write from a farmhouse in the northern hills, where they claim the stars are still reliably on.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Ivo Nakamura's POV. We meet the debt-bound scribe copying temple ledgers in a valley where magic cannot exist, chafing at walls he has never questioned. When he accidentally transcribes a forbidden glyph, ink moves on its own. Emotional beat: quiet longing cracked open by wonder.

chapters.title: The Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The border wards fall with a sound like shattering glass; every star vanishes at once. Temple elders panic, and Ivo's debt-holder claims an ancient clause: the scribe must serve outside the valley. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration entwined as the known world ends.

chapters.title: A Debt Paid in Blood
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Crossing the border, magic floods into him painfully, revealing his latent talent for unbinding spells. Ward-knight Sera Voss arrests him as a suspected saboteur, then realizes the wards fell around him, not because of him. Emotional beat: hostile first meeting masking mutual recognition.

chapters.title: The Knight Who Broke Her Oath
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Sera explains the fallen wards and her own disgrace: she once reported corruption in the crown and was exiled to border duty. She needs Ivo's unbinding gift; he needs protection. An uneasy alliance forms. Emotional beat: two outcasts negotiating trust.

chapters.title: Roads Where Maps End
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Traveling toward the capital, they find villages where people have forgotten loved ones — memories eaten alongside starlight. Ivo unbinds a minor hunger-ward in a well, saving a child, and word spreads. Emotional beat: first taste of purpose beyond debt.

chapters.title: What the Hollow Regent Wants
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. At a waystation, a dying courier reveals the king issued a decree conscripting all gifted 'binders' to the palace. Sera suspects the summons is bait set by whatever wears the crown. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Following clues in his own family name, they find a hidden archive: Ivo's ancestors wrote the original Great Binding that created the star-wards — and the valley was its vault. His blood is the key. Emotional beat: identity upended; he was never ordinary.

chapters.title: Hunted Through the Ashwood
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Crown hunters ambush them in a forest gone grey and starless. Sera fights while Ivo unbinds their pursuers' enchanted chains, an act that costs him days of strength. Emotional beat: reliance deepening into something neither will name.

chapters.title: Fever and Confession
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Ivo burns with backlash fever; Sera keeps vigil, confessing to his sleeping form why she truly broke her oath — she loved someone the order destroyed. He half-hears. Emotional beat: love admitted where it cannot be answered.

chapters.title: The City of Borrowed Light
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. They reach the capital, lit by hoarded lantern-glow, where citizens worship the starless sky as salvation. Propaganda paints the vanished stars as a cleansing. Emotional beat: horror at how easily fear becomes faith.

chapters.title: An Audience With the Crown
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Posing as summoned binders, they enter the palace and see the king: hollow-eyed, smiling wrong, his shadow moving independently. The Hollow Regent greets Ivo by his ancestor's name. Emotional beat: skin-crawling recognition — it has been waiting for him.

chapters.title: The Thing Wearing Him
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the royal library, Ivo touches the king's hand and glimpses inside: the true king, Kaelen, imprisoned within his own body, still fighting. The Regent offers Ivo power and knowledge of his parents' fate. Emotional beat: temptation against compassion.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Lantern Gate
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. A former comrade exposes them; Sera is captured defending Ivo's escape, publicly branded an oathbreaker. Ivo flees alone into the undercity, hating himself for running. Emotional beat: guilt, loss, and the cost of survival made literal.

chapters.title: The Undercity's Forgotten
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Hiding among the capital's dispossessed — people the Regent's feeding has hollowed — Ivo finds community for the first time. They shelter him not for his gift but for himself. Emotional beat: belonging discovered among the broken.

chapters.title: Kaelen's Last Letter
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Using archive knowledge, Ivo reaches the king's sealed childhood letters and learns the binding ritual requires a willing anchor of the founder's blood — a life given freely, forever. Emotional beat: the price named plainly, hope and grief in one breath.

chapters.title: Breaking Into the Deep Vault
chapters.summary: Undercity allies help Ivo infiltrate the palace vault where the original Binding Stone lies shattered. He reassembles it, but the Regent anticipated him — Sera is brought in as leverage. Emotional beat: trap sprung, choices collapsing.

chapters.title: The Bargain
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The Regent offers a trade: Sera's life for Ivo's cooperation in completing its devouring of the sky. Sera begs him to refuse; Ivo pretends to accept, buying time with a hidden unbinding woven into his surrender. Emotional beat: love weaponized, then turned.

chapters.title: Unbinding the King
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the coronation altar, Ivo springs his counter-weave, peeling the Regent off Kaelen's soul in a battle fought through memory and language rather than steel. The true king wakes, weeping. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by exhaustion — and the Regent isn't destroyed, only displaced.

chapters.title: The Devourer Unleashed
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. The Regent abandons the king and pours itself into the wounded sky directly. Kaelen, too damaged to fight, gives Ivo the crown's last authority: access to the Binding Stone's heart. Emotional beat: all plans burned away; only sacrifice remains.

chapters.title: The Glass Steppe
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. On the fused-glass plain where the wards first fell, Ivo offers himself as the living anchor, rewriting his ancestors' covenant with his own words: a binding sustained by choice, not bloodline. The stars reignite one by one as the Regent unravels. Emotional beat: transcendence through surrender.

chapters.title: After the Light Returns
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. The valley's old isolation dissolves; its people grieve and celebrate. Kaelen, restored but changed, abolishes debt-bondage in Ivo's name. Sera refuses reinstatement to her order. Emotional beat: mourning braided with renewal.

chapters.title: Where You Are Is Home
chapters.summary: Dual POV closing chapter. Sera travels to the glass steppe where Ivo endures as the wards' living heart — visible as a figure of faint starlight. She builds a house at the boundary line, and each night he steps down from the steppe to share it, anchored yet free enough to belong. Emotional beat: love against duty resolved — duty transformed into home.
